title: Unversioned Binary Serialization / Out-of-Sync DTOs (UNVERSIONED_BINARY_SERIALIZATION)
pattern: Serializing structures directly to custom binary streams without encoding version markers, field tag identifiers, or metadata schemas.
why_bad: It is highly fragile. Any subsequent code modification (e.g., adding an optional field or reordering elements) completely corrupts historical serializations, causing immediate parsing errors on deserialization.
detection: Look for byte packing logic that writes record attributes sequentially without pre-assigned tag numbers, field names, or global format versions.
fix: Wrap binary messages in a versioned envelope (carrying an integer tag of the schema version) or utilize schema serialization mechanisms (like Protobuf tags) to permit ignored fields.
source: *Martin Fowler - Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture (2002)*, page 401; *Vaughn Vernon - Implementing Domain-Driven Design (2013)*, Chapter 14.
